episodes.title: Renunciation Of Over 500 Secret Cult Members In Edo | UDUOTA
episodes.description:
Inside Governor Monday Okpebholo’s strategic amnesty program aimed at building a safer Edo State.

Following the historic mass voluntary renunciation of over 500 secret cult members in Benin City, Edo State has initiated an extensive, multi-layered rehabilitation and enforcement strategy.

Governor Monday Okpebholo formally granted amnesty to the repentant youths under the theme "Restitution, Rehabilitation and Safer Edo State," establishing a concrete roadmap for what happens next.
